metadata.title: About the Workshop, Team & Service Standards
metadata.description: Learn about Red Power Garage, our specialist automotive team, and the professional service standards behind our diagnostics, maintenance, and performance work.

hero.eyebrow: We are more than just a workshop.
hero.title: Our passion is cars and our mission is trust
hero.description: At Red Power Garage, we provide professional care for your vehicle that combines technical expertise with genuine passion. Our specialized team ensures maintenance and repair services with the highest quality standards, with full commitment to transparency and reliability in every step.
hero.imageAlt: Red Power Garage about page hero with Dodge workshop background

passion.title: Experience built on passion
passion.description: Our goal at Red Power Garage is to provide car maintenance and repair services with complete transparency and high reliability. We put customer satisfaction first, and always work to deliver an exceptional service experience that exceeds your expectations.
